settings.heading: ABOUT US
settings.text: Agent Issues is an independent print magazine based in Paris. Twice a year we pick one idea and chase it through fashion, art, music, games and the internet: 200+ pages in English, half text, half image. Issue 01 asked who gets credit for inspo. Our contributors work in Paris, Berlin, Tokyo, Montreal, London and Warsaw.
